newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee barely changed against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee barely changed against dollar.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed barely changed against the dollar in thin volume and narrow ranges, dealers said.

The rupee closed at 56.68 to the dollar after opening at 56.69, compared with a close of 56.70 on Tuesday. "The exchange rate moved in a range of a couple of cents, mainly because it is a very quiet month," said an ABN Amro Bank dealer.
Overnight call money closed at 13.75 percent, with the market well offered, he said.
